verdict.rationale: New Relic documents official APM/agent SDKs for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby, plus dedicated SDK components for building New Relic apps and SDK-based Lambda instrumentation, giving AI-native developers multiple official language SDKs to build against. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK quality or completeness beyond first-party docs, and no explicit AI/agent-specific SDK beyond general agents.
